questions.question: Which language should the LearnLoop frontend use?
questions.rationale: The request explicitly asks for a new Expo TypeScript app.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed React Native code with safer shared lesson and state models.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: JavaScript React Native code without static typing.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and navigation approach should LearnLoop use?
questions.answer: Expo React Native with React Navigation bottom tabs
questions.rationale: The existing App1 project demonstrates the requested bottom-tab pattern with React Navigation, while keeping the new app independent.

options.label: Expo React Native with React Navigation bottom tabs
options.description: A straightforward Expo TypeScript app with three native bottom-tab screens.

options.label: Expo Router tabs
options.description: File-based routing with an Expo Router tab layout.

questions.recommendedChoice: Expo React Native with React Navigation bottom tabs

questions.question: Which data stores does LearnLoop require?
questions.rationale: The request explicitly describes local data and an offline app, with no persistence service.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use bundled local lesson data and in-memory bookmark and learned state.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: A relational cloud database for persisted application data.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploaded or served media files.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to access LearnLoop application features?
questions.rationale: The requested offline learning experience has no account or sign-in requirement.

options.label: No
options.description: The app is available locally without accounts.

options.label: Yes
